summary: K Wave Media Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its indirect wholly owned subsidiary, Playverse Co. Ltd., completed a purchase of 5,864,088 shares (42.25% stake) of Hansol Inticube Co. from Hansol Holdings and other sellers for KRW 15,000,337,104 (approx. USD 11.4M, ~$1.95/share). The deal closed on March 10, 2026, with board control obtained. Filed as pro forma financials and audited statements. No premium or break fee stated. Key watch item: integration of AI capabilities and potential squeeze-out or further investment.
